## Pages in this subsection

- [pudl.dagster.assets.core](index.html.md): Core Dagster asset-definition modules for PUDL.
- [pudl.dagster.assets.core.datapackage](datapackage/index.html.md): Dagster asset that generates the PUDL frictionless datapackage descriptor.
- [pudl.dagster.assets.core.eiaapi_electricity](eiaapi_electricity/index.html.md): Dagster assets for EIA API electricity aggregates.
- [pudl.dagster.assets.core.glue](glue/index.html.md): Dagster assets for cross-dataset glue tables.
- [pudl.dagster.assets.core.static](static/index.html.md): Dagster assets for static reference tables.
- [pudl.dagster.assets.core.unmapped_ids](unmapped_ids/index.html.md): Dagster assets identifying FERC1/EIA plant &amp; utility IDs missing manual mapping.
